heading: Wednesday, October 29, 2025
topLine: OpenAI releases open-weight gpt-oss-safeguard safety models.

items.headline: OpenAI releases open-weight gpt-oss-safeguard safety models
items.summary: gpt-oss-safeguard-120b and -20b are open-weight safety-classification reasoning models fine-tuned from gpt-oss under Apache 2.0, released as a research preview. Developers supply their own policy at inference time; the models were built with ROOST, Discord and SafetyKit.
